notes.title: Update 0.3 - Decoration & Customization
notes.content:
[previewyoutube="Wug8y-Ol9gA;full"][/previewyoutube]
Hello dear Sandwichers! 🥪✨

We’re thrilled to share the very first major update of our Early Access journey with you!
The 0.3 "Decoration Update" is now live! 🎉

With this update, you’ll be able to personalize your restaurant like never before. From new decoration options to a variety of customization features, your place can truly reflect your unique style and atmosphere. Your restaurant is no longer just a spot to serve food—it’s a space that feels entirely your own.

But that’s not all! Alongside these exciting new additions, we’ve also focused heavily on improving the overall experience. Many bugs have been fixed, making your journey smoother and more enjoyable.

We invite you to check out the brand-new update trailer to see all the fresh content in action. 🎬

Thank you for being part of the very first big step in the Sandwich Simulator adventure. This is just the beginning, and we can’t wait to keep growing together with you! 🌟



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621806/6edbc001d10c24a83c52c19b26fded75ad291cb5.gif"]



Let’s dive into the Decoration Update!
Customizable Kitchen Colors
Bring your kitchen to life with the colors you love!

Not only can you now change the stone colors of your walls, but we’ve also added 3 different countertop styles for you to choose from. Simply use the Color Picker to select your preferred shade and watch your kitchen transform instantly.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621806/38ddaa7f94b93bad45f8369a2b66657a17d0dd6f.gif"]


Customizable Restaurant Hall
Your restaurant hall just got a major glow-up!
You can freely adjust the colors of the walls, along with both the upper and lower stone layers, giving your space a completely fresh atmosphere.

On top of that, we’ve added 3 brand-new floor tile options (4 in total), allowing you to pick the perfect pattern that matches your interior design.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621806/5bde610345e4c88d69a656565a6d22df43167826.gif"]


🎨 Customizable Decoration Items
Make your restaurant truly yours with a wide variety of customizable decor pieces:

10 ceiling lamps

18 wall frames

14 shelves

6 wall signs

Choose the styles that fit your taste and create the perfect atmosphere!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621806/7ddf896efe46a7302c82c3fd671281fcfbf8c619.gif"]


🪑 Fixed Decoration Items
On top of that, we’ve added plenty of fixed decorative pieces to make your restaurant feel more alive and cozy:

3 ceiling fans

4 wind chimes

3 wall lamps

17 posters

48 house decor items including details like a pipe, an airplane and boat model, a globe, animal figurines, and many more charming objects!

Your restaurant isn’t just a business anymore—it’s a world full of character, shaped by your own choices.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621806/d00e0c60ac96a0e16ade2e68503912db5d42cc5c.gif"]


🐞 Bug Fixes
We’ve also tackled a number of issues to make your experience smoother:

Player Stuck in Toilet While Crouching
Fixed an issue where crouching inside a toilet could trap the player, making it impossible to exit.

Invisible Sandwich After Save/Load with Tray & Receipt
Resolved a bug where serving a tray with a receipt after save/load left behind an invisible sandwich.

Clients Facing the Same Direction in Multiplayer
Fixed client orientation not replicating correctly for other players. No more oddly synchronized staring contests!

Small Freezer Preview Image Mismatch
Corrected the preview image in the market so it now matches the actual in-game appearance.

Bread Sorting into Oven Tray (Client-Side)
Addressed an issue where trays sometimes failed to properly hold 5 breads, causing odd shifting or fewer breads being placed.

Order Price Drops to Zero
Fixed an issue where removing a sandwich from the order list while taking the order caused the total price to drop to zero.

Broken Sandwich Order After Removing Side Item
Resolved a bug where removing a selected side item would break the sandwich order in the list.

Cash Register Price Increase Exploit
Addressed an exploit where switching repeatedly between certain products (such as different bread types or chicken/smoked beef) would incorrectly increase the total price.

Canceled Items Still Appearing on Receipt
Fixed an issue where canceled bread and ingredients still showed up on the printed receipt.

Example: If White Bread, Chicken, and Lettuce were ordered, and White Bread was removed, those removed items could still appear when the order was changed to something else (e.g., Thyme Bread, Smoked Beef, and Mushroom). This has now been resolved.

Drive-Thru Old Orders Persisting After Save/Load
Corrected a problem where the large order panel in the drive-thru continued to display old or kicked orders after a save/load.



[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/54263/ContractVille_X_Sandwich_Simulator/"][/dynamiclink]

notes.title: Update 0.2.3.3 - Upcoming Updates & Inverted Mouse Setting & Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Hello Sandwichers!

In this update, we’ve focused on the bugs you reported and worked on fixing the major issues that negatively affected your gameplay experience.
We’re aware that there are still a few minor bugs left — most of them don’t impact your experience significantly, but we’ll keep working to squash them one by one. Please continue reporting any issues you notice so we can make your experience as smooth as possible.

On top of bug fixes, we’re also working on improvements and new features to make the game even more enjoyable.
Your feedback about the game’s difficulty, fun factor, and anything else is incredibly valuable to us. We read and consider every single message you post in the #suggestions channel on our Discord server.

And here’s a little sneak peek — we’re moving forward according to our Roadmap, and in August, you’ll be getting some exciting new updates:

Decoration Color Customization

Decoration Variations

Floor & Wall Customization

Together, we’re making Sandwich Simulator even better!


[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/54263/ContractVille_X_Sandwich_Simulator/"][/dynamiclink]
Inverted Mouse Setting
In this update, we have fulfilled the request of our esteemed player Rudolf Fischer, which he shared with us in the Steam Discussions section. We thank him for sharing it with us.

With the newly added ‘Inverted Mouse’ option, you can reverse mouse movements and control the camera the way you’re used to.

You can enable this setting from Settings > Controls.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621806/d2867d4326504a720cfaa858fe54142fa273c2de.png"]

Bug FixesGameplay & Interaction
Furniture positions now load correctly after saving and reloading the game.

Customer moods are now preserved correctly; happy customers will no longer become sad after saving and reloading.

Customers in a mad state during saving now properly return to their seated positions after reloading.

Selling tables while customers are seated is no longer possible, preventing animation and state errors.
UI & Controls
Order panel scrolling has been improved to prevent it from breaking when scrolled after unfocusing the panel.

Table numbering has been corrected to prevent duplicate numbers when placement is interrupted by another player’s actions.

Closing placement mode while holding a table no longer causes its table number to be lost.
Objects & Placement
Wall-mountable items now align properly with walls, fixing an issue where they snapped at incorrect angles.

Bread oven ghost mesh now displays correctly when first picked up after purchase.
Audio
Unwrapping sandwiches that contain sauce no longer replays the sauce pouring sound effect.
[hr][/hr]Coming Soon | a reminder
We’re moving forward with our roadmap, and in August, you can expect these exciting additions:

Decoration Color Customization

Decoration Variations

Floor & Wall Customization

notes.title: Update 0.2.3 - Bug Fixes & Road Map Updated
notes.content:
Hey Sandwich Makers!

Last week, we brought German, Russian, French, Polish, and Turkish to Sandwich Simulator.
This week, we’ve got even more exciting news: we’ve updated our roadmap! Your feedback — especially from our solo players — has been heard loud and clear, and we’re shaping the game’s future with you in mind.

And don’t worry, we’re still squashing bugs left and right to make sure your sandwich shop runs smoother than ever.

Remember, this is Early Access — you’re helping decide where Sandwich Simulator goes from here. So tell your friends, keep sharing your thoughts, and if you haven’t already, drop us a review. It really helps us keep building the game together!



[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/54263/ContractVille_X_Sandwich_Simulator/"][/dynamiclink]

Improvements & Balancing
With these changes we aim to reduce the difficulty.

NEW SANDWICH MAKER MACHINE & NEW LOCALIZATIONS 
Road Map Updated
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621806/8481d6ee8b0b32611643812e54f5a38a491187f3.png"]
Coming Soon: Sandwich Maker Machine
We’ve heard from many of our solo players — especially at higher levels — that keeping up with sandwich orders can get overwhelming. After a few balancing tweaks, we’re taking things a step further to make life easier:

Introducing the Sandwich Maker Machine!
This machine will automatically prepare an order when you scan a ticket, as long as all the necessary ingredients are available. We’ve already started working on it, and it’s planned for release in September.
[hr][/hr]New Localizations
We’re continuing to expand Sandwich Simulator to players around the world! In September, we’ll be adding 7 new languages based on community requests and our long-term goals:

Italian, Spanish, Japanese, Korean, Chinese, Portuguese, and Dutch.
[hr][/hr]
We can’t wait to hear your thoughts on our updated roadmap. We hope these upcoming features and additions get you as excited as they make us!




BUG FIXES
Customers in Line Before Save/Load:
Fixed an issue where customers waiting in line during save/load couldn’t sit at tables.

Spoiled Sandwiches:
Spoiled sandwiches can no longer be served and eaten by customers.

Customer Teleportation After Save/Load:
Resolved an issue where some seated customers teleported to the world origin after loading a save.

Skip Tutorial Tooltip:
Corrected the duplicated and incorrect “Hold T to Skip Tutorial” message. It now properly displays “Hold Y.”

Unresponsive Diners After Save/Load:
Fixed an issue where customers eating during save/load became stuck and unresponsive.

Fridge Item Position Desync:
Items inside fridges now appear in the correct positions for clients after joining post-save/load.

Default 4 Tables Issue:
New restaurants no longer spawn with four tables all numbered “4.”

Coffee Machine Interaction:
Coffee beans can now be successfully added to the coffee machine.

Ingredient Widget Display:
Resolved an issue where some ingredient icons displayed as blank white squares.

Mouse Scroll Interaction:
Fixed an issue where mouse scroll stopped working after interacting with certain objects.

Ordering Customers:
Customers in the middle of ordering can now be kicked as intended.

Settings Dropdown Boxes:
Dropdown menus in the General Settings menu no longer appear empty by default.

Queue Disappearing Customer:
Fixed a bug where the first customer in line disappeared when a second customer joined the queue.

Customer Falls Through Floor on Client:
Resolved an issue where the first ordering customer on clients fell through the floor after ordering.

Waiter Spawn Locations After End Day:
Waiters now respawn at the correct positions after ending the day.

Customer Pathfinding Issues:
Fixed an issue where customers got stuck on their way to tables and eventually disappeared.

Tray-Laptop Interaction:
Resolved an issue where a laptop in use could be carried away on a tray by another player.

Laptop Placement:
Laptops can no longer be placed on trays.

Ice Cream Machine After Save/Load:
The ice cream machine now functions correctly after a save/load, even if a cup was inserted.

Logo Change:
Changing the restaurant logo via the laptop now properly updates it in-game.

Latte Orders Unlocking:
Latte requests now correctly align with the intended unlock level.

Floating Bread After Save/Load:
Bread no longer floats after picking up oven trays post-save/load.

Floating Fridge Items:
Items inside fridges now move properly when the fridge is relocated after save/load.

Women’s Restroom Visual Issue:
Fixed flickering (Z-fighting) textures in the women’s restroom.

Item Placement Desync:
Items moved by the host now display correctly for players who join later.

notes.title: Update 0.2.1 - Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Hello Sandwichers!

With this update, we continue to address bugs.

We are updating our roadmap based on your suggestions and feedback. We will soon announce our updated roadmap.

I would like to remind you that, in addition to your suggestions and feedback, your positive reviews and recommendations to your friends are also very valuable to us in helping us improve Sandwich Simulator.

 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621806/eaa1e1f186605eeb9cca54f943e765f296e69c8c.png"]
You can purchase Sandwich Simulator at a 33% discount during the Summer Sale. If you want to give it as a gift to your friends, now is a good time!
I would also like to remind you that our ContractVille game is now 40% off.

If you would like to take advantage of a bundle with Sandwich Simulator, I have included the bundle below:

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/54263/ContractVille_X_Sandwich_Simulator/"][/dynamiclink]If you would like to participate in our ongoing giveaway to celebrate the Steam Summer Sale and our upcoming update: Sandwich Simulator

[dynamiclink href=""][/dynamiclink]
🛠️ Patch Notes – Bug Fixes & Improvements
Gameplay & Progression

Difficulty Reset Issue Fixed
Fixed an issue where the game difficulty would reset to "Normal" after completing a day.
Difficulty levels are now saved after Save/Load. So if you started a game on “Hard” difficulty, it will appear as ‘Hard’ again when you re-enter. Previously, it would revert to “Normal.”

UI & Visuals

Floating Bowl Bug Resolved
Bowls no longer remain floating after the preparation station is relocated.

Missing Logos After Load
Fixed a bug where some logos would disappear after loading a save.

Multiplayer & Sync

Jukebox Synchronization Fixed
Resolved desynchronization issues between players when using the jukebox:

Stopping the jukebox on one client no longer causes the opposite state on the other.

Both players now see consistent play/stop states.

Fixed the bug where only the player who stopped the jukebox first would see correct behavior.

Item Handling & Interactions

Stacking Behavior Improved
Visual and mechanical inconsistencies when stacking items have been fixed.

Tray Interaction Fix
Interaction with fully loaded trays using a scoop is now smoother and more reliable.

Coffee Machine Cup Placement
Clients can now correctly place cups into the coffee machine.

AI & Pathfinding

Courier Blocking NPCs Fixed
Couriers waiting for online orders no longer block waiter or customer NPCs.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621806/6b695477a6d025505e4cd125a35fab586767e737.gif"]

That means more fun, more action, and more chaos!

With this update, you can add two more people to your group of four friends.

Now, with 6-player co-op support, you can turn the kitchen upside down with even larger teams.

Should you divide tasks, or have everyone jump into the bread-making fray at the same time? The choice is yours!

notes.title: Roadmap Announcement & Update 0.1.1.7
notes.content:
Hey Sandwichers! 👋
We’ve been cooking up something special behind the scenes! Today’s update not only includes major bug fixes but also a sneak peek at the future of Sandwich Simulator. Check out our Roadmap to see what exciting features are on the way! 🚀


📅 Early Access Roadmap
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621806/5705acc1d3603263ea816ad22e1ce06d396319ef.png"]

🧑‍🤝‍🧑 July – 6-Player Co-op Support

More friends, more chaos! You’ll be able to manage your kitchen with up to 6 players.

🎨 August – Decoration Customization

Customize decoration colors

New decoration style variations

Floor & wall customization options

🧩 September – 8-Player Co-op Support

Even more teamwork (or teamwork disasters 😅) with support for up to 8 players!

🎵 October – Jukebox Update & Employee NPC Customization

Add your own music tracks to the jukebox

Customize the appearance of your staff NPCs

🚀 December – Full Release!

Sandwich Simulator is going 1.0! 🎉
Along with the launch, we’re introducing a brand-new feature:
🌭 Hot Dog Stand – new recipes, ingredients, and an all-new gameplay twist!



[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3445340/?snr=2"][/dynamiclink]
🔧 Bug Fixes
Some of the bug fixes mentioned in these notes may include hotfixes released this week.

Extra Space Removed in Difficulty Menus
Fixed unintended spacing after "Hard" in the Patience Difficulty section and "Nightmare" in the main Difficulty menu.

Missing Vanilla Ice Cream Image Restored
Vanilla ice cream now displays the correct image in the order UI.

Coffee Drinking Animation Added
Customers now correctly play the drinking animation when consuming coffee.

Market Item Quantity Labels Fixed
Labels now accurately reflect the number of units delivered (e.g., Bread and Chicken pack counts now match their labels).

Jukebox/Cooker Save-Load Exploit Fixed
Fixed an exploit where selling and reloading would cause previously sold items to reappear, enabling infinite money.

Customers Now Drink Their Beverages
Fixed an issue where customers would not drink their ordered drinks.

Iced Drink Widgets Now Visually Distinct
Iced drinks are now properly distinguishable from regular drinks in the UI.

Ingredient Bowls and Drink Cups Stack Correctly
Overlapping issues with ingredient bowls and drink cups have been resolved.

Toilet Stall Access Corrected
After the first toilet upgrade, customers will no longer use the area reserved for the future third stall.

Ice Cream Machine Can No Longer Be Refilled Infinitely
Refill is now correctly limited by available supply; empty boxes can’t be used to refill.

Wall Decorations Now Appear After Upgrades
TVs and wall frames now correctly appear on newly unlocked walls.

Drink-Only Orders No Longer Show Sandwich Trash
Trays with only drinks, ice cream, or coffee no longer show sandwich wrappers.

Waiter Trash Disposal Pathing Fixed
Waiters will no longer get stuck when attempting to use unfamiliar or overlapping trash bins.

Clear Cart Function No Longer Hides Order Panel
Clearing the cart no longer causes the customer order panel to disappear.

Discount System Synced for All Players
Clients can now see which items are discounted, and discounts apply properly in the cart.

Tray Interaction Restored After Save/Load or Customer Removal
Trays no longer become unresponsive after loading or ending the day.

Mouse Cursor No Longer Disappears in Character Creation
Opening the pause menu in character creation no longer hides the cursor upon return.

Double Waiter Interaction on Same Order Fixed
Only one waiter can now process a given customer order at a time.

Online Orders in Relaxed Mode No Longer Have a Timer
Relaxed mode now removes time limits for online orders, as intended.

Nuggets & Onion Rings Order Logic Fixed
Customers now accept and consume orders that include nuggets and onion rings properly.

Ice Cream and Drinks Now Ordered After Unlock Day
Customers will continue to order these items on days after they are unlocked.

Dirt Meter Behavior Fixed
The dirtiness meter no longer starts full or immediately penalizes fame upon loading.

If you’d like to report bugs, share suggestions, or tell us what’s on your mind, join the FiftyEight Studios Discord server and be part of the conversation!



If you would like to follow our social media accounts, you can find "More Ways To Connect" section below.

notes.title: Update 0.1.1.3
notes.content:
Hey Sandwichers!

In these update notes, we're covering the changes and bug fixes introduced in versions 0.1.1.2 and 0.1.1.3. Right after releasing this update, we’ll continue working on addressing the smaller issues still on our list. We’re actively reading everything you share with us on Discord and Steam Discussions, and we're quick to act on the problems you report. Thank you so much for all the feedback and support you've given us so far!

If you’d like to report bugs, share suggestions, or tell us what’s on your mind, join the FiftyEight Studios Discord server and be part of the conversation!

We’d also like to give a special shoutout to a few players who helped us identify key issues in this update:
ssmith, rock_playerz, luca1981, ChromeEaglezZ, Gabbywolf, Imelda, Quinn, GraphiteHelix, J I L L.



Thanks again for all your support and feedback. Let’s dive in!



[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3445340/?snr=2"][/dynamiclink]
Patience Diffuculty
Based on your feedback, we’ve made some adjustments to the difficulty settings.
Relax mode has been removed, and its settings have been transferred to the existing Easy mode.

Additionally, we’ve separated the patience timer from the overall difficulty and introduced three new patience options.
This gives you more control over how relaxed or challenging you want the experience to be.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621806/9379ab0ff7a308822f567edf8e34c3d7fb237cce.png"]

[table equalcells="1" colwidth=""][tr][th]
Patience Diffuculty
[/th][/tr][/table][table equalcells="1" colwidth="69,"][tr][th colwidth="69"]
Easy
[/th][td]
Customers have no patience timers and will not leave the restaurant.
[/td][/tr][tr][th colwidth="69"]
Normal
[/th][td]
Customers have a patience timer of 70 seconds for one tense. Once it runs out, they will leave the restaurant.
[/td][/tr][tr][th colwidth="69"]
Hard
[/th][td]
Customers have a patience timer of 35 seconds for one tense. Once it runs out, they will leave the restaurant.
[/td][/tr][/table]

Laptop is now movable!
You can now reposition the laptop by interacting with it in Placement Mode.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621806/c6ab6fbfcd9a216c9ebd742ac47a05042396d6aa.gif"]


Incorrect Display of Earned Money
Before version 0.1.1.2, we increased the amount of money earned to offer a more comfortable gameplay experience. However, the total order prices shown in the order screen were not reflecting this change correctly. With version 0.1.1.3, this issue has been fixed. The displayed values now accurately match the updated earnings.

We believe this improvement helps bring better balance to the in-game economy, and we’ll be keeping a close eye on your feedback moving forward.


Online Orders
Online orders have received a general overhaul and now work more reliably and accurately.
We've made several improvements in this area to ensure a smoother experience.


Fries Warmer
We fixed an issue where a scoop placed in the Fries Warmer could get stuck, making it impossible to interact with and complete fry orders.
Thanks to your reports, we were able to identify and resolve this quickly. The fix was included in version 0.1.1.2.


End-of-Day Summary
Fixed a bug that caused the total number of sandwich orders shown in the end-of-day summary to be incorrect.


Early Ordering of Certain Items
Resolved an issue where customers could order certain items — like nuggets or pickles — before you had officially unlocked them.

Now, customers will only order new items once you've reached the required level, as intended.


Side Items
Fixed a bug where, after unlocking side items like drinks, customers would order only those items for 1–2 days — and then stop ordering them altogether.

Now, as intended, drinks and other side items can continue to appear in customer orders in the following days.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621806/1772351e5077b6f130d3d78579d698e853676943.png"]

General Improvements and Fixes
Various minor bugs have been fixed, and visual improvements have been made across the game.

We’ve also applied stability and accuracy improvements in several areas — especially related to the waiter.



If you would like to follow our social media accounts, you can find "More Ways To Connect" section below.

notes.title: Sandwich Simulator - Update 0.1.1.0
notes.content:
Hello Sandwichers! 
In this update, we're fixing a lot of bugs and getting one step closer to making Sandwich Simulator a smoother game. I would like to remind you that we read all your comments and we are editing the game based on your feedback, so you can give us more comments.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3445340/?snr=2
🛠️ Patch Notes

🎛️ Main Menu Improvement

 We've added a widget to the Main Menu where you can see the progress of your game in your previous saves. You can now see how many levels you are in a save and your money.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621806/8b5a5cf0c7fcb46d6b223de22d6ca8a50260b13f.png

🧼 General Gameplay & Stability Fixes

 Removed spoilage timers — products no longer rot over time in freezer and cold storage.
 Game difficulty rebalanced for smoother, more stable progression.
 Fixed various SFX-related network issues.
 Fixed bug where random ice cream or drinks were added to receipts.
 Special First Day Checklist has been added to guide new players.
 Progression bar is now shown even for items that have amounts.
 Fixed save/load issues with NPC worker behavior.
 Major bug fixes applied to Drive-Thru functionality.
 Autosave can now be toggled ON/OFF from the Options menu.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621806/3250fa6b490f792aec363a3631062f18e248fb0a.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621806/9bbc29e0f32dd75bc6fbd15be0b2b93c64b79fac.png

🧾 Orders & Receipts

 Fixed order panel bugs that caused UI glitches.
 Resolved issue where previous ice cream, drinks, fries, nuggets, or onion rings would persist on the receipt after placing a new order without them.
 Orders now clear from the panel correctly after a day change.
 Empty drink values in the customer order widget have been fixed.
 NPCs can now properly see customer orders.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621806/fb9537c3201d0203221e51dbf544d04afab8be2e.gif

🍔 Food Handling & Serving

 Sandwiches can no longer be served without wrapping.
 Bread types now have updated UI icons for easier identification.
 Fixed bug allowing players to place bread on already full oven trays.
 Ice cream no longer disappears when placed on stacked cups.
 Fixed exploit allowing unlimited fries, nuggets, and onion rings.
 Waiter-placed trays now correctly show more than just two trays.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621806/e9d85baf6673c0ad72b323bda69fb9c81c0e64f2.gif

🚻 Toilet & Cleaning Mechanics

 Toilet cleaning widget no longer gets stuck.
 Urinal divider in men’s toilet repositioned correctly.
 Toilet doors can no longer be locked from the inside if there’s no keyhole.
 Level 10 customers no longer request toilet use.
 Toilet interaction bugs with customers have been fixed.
 Players can now see the toilet brush and mop when held by cleaning staff.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621806/ee7c0b6d96853637401720e7fa3899f887d6b620.png

🧑‍🍳 NPC Workers & Helpers

 NPC waiter now functions correctly.
 Resolved inconsistencies in worker hiring screen.
 Helpers no longer appear stacked inside each other after day end.
 Waiters now detect the default trash bin location properly.
 Save/load inconsistencies with NPC workers have been addressed.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621806/8ff4a5fc76140815ae7f6ab350d28272759bafb1.png

🖥️ UI & Visual Improvements

 Tutorials section updated and expanded with new information.
 Outdated End-of-Day tutorial thumbnail replaced with latest version.
 Order panel no longer disappears if placed on a wall that’s removed due to kitchen upgrades.
 Customer order section on the cash register repositioned — no longer blocks background products.
 Frame limit setting now correctly reappears after reopening Options.
 Drive-Thru driver and customer hand positions corrected for consistency.
 Drink cup stack texture now matches the in-hand placed version.
 Fixed stuck "Enter" key issue on the laptop UI.
 Tutorial text overlapping issues resolved.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621806/22f228d7bba4424c2b1dcfc0a74a8923d1a25131.gif

🚗 Drive-Thru & Online Ordering

 Missing Drive-Thru tutorial content added.
 Fixed Drive-Thru customer and vehicle interaction inconsistencies.
 Resolved slip/receipt data mismatches in online orders.
 Added missing open/close SFX for delivery packages.
 Fixed Drive-Thru customer ID and order mismatches.
 Drive-Thru on-off setting added. You can turn Drive-Thru on and off by pressing the F key from the Drive-Thru cash register.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621806/ef9f16bc097020e671dc3f8deb7b8d90d92aee12.png

💾 Save/Load Related Fixes

 Fixed misalignment and late loading of trays and sandwiches after save/load.
 Drive-Thru behavior now consistent after reloading a saved game.


🧱 Miscellaneous

 Fixed bug where players could sell multiple items at the exact same time.
 Resolved issue where players joining a game after idling in the main menu caused instability.

 Minor bug fixes implemented.
 And much more...
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621806/89715f6614d4bc067b511ff860d804b007b8ca07.png

We will continue to read your complaints and make adjustments and improvements. Thank you again for supporting us. 
You can join our Discord server and send us your suggestions and complaints directly. 

If you would like to follow our social media accounts, you can find "More Ways To Connect" section below.

notes.title: Sandwich Simulator - Update 0.1.0.8
notes.content:
Hello Sandwichers!

It's been 4 days since our game was released and we would like to thank you for your understanding and support. We are excited to be on this journey with you throughout our Early Access period.
We read everything you post in discussions and reviews and we take everything you criticize and suggest very seriously. 

In this update, we've taken your feedback into account and made many fixes and improvements. We'll be following what you say again in the coming days and will continue to improve the game based on your criticism. So please continue to follow us and comment on the game. You can be sure that we will work very hard to make Sandwich Simulator the best it can be. 

Reviews
  At this stage, every comment and criticism is very valuable to us. In these four days since the early access release, we've fixed a lot of things that negatively impacted your gaming experience with a few hotfixes. 
 I would like to say that every positive review means a lot to us. Despite some bugs, we are very motivated by your support and your belief that the game will continue to evolve and improvements will continue to be made. 
Road Map

 In the coming days, we will publish a 2025 Road Map and announce what's coming to the game. 
 Right now, our priority will be to fix critical bugs and make improvements to the things that are detrimental to your gaming experience.

Localization

 I would like our players who expect localization to know that we are aware of their expectations. You can be sure that we will work on this issue in the future.
 

Our Introductory Offer is still live! Buy it or gift it to a friend if you have it.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3445340/?snr=2

What Does This Update Include?
Some of these are hotfixes that we made in these four days.


 Relax Mod has been added: We've brought you the easiest gameplay mode where customers don't run out of patience and get angry and leave the restaurant.
 A Little More Time: In all modes, customers' patience time has been extended by 30 seconds.
 We Didn't Pass the Level 2 Empty: Lettuce now unlocks at level 2 instead of level 3.
 We Heard The R Key Feedback: You said it was annoying to keep pressing R to open placement mode, and we've removed that. Now placement mode opens automatically on everything except furniture. If you want to turn it off, you can press R again.
 General UI Improvements: Many UI fixes and improvements have been implemented. One of them is... You can now see what day it is on the top right next to the clock. I would like to remind you that you can also see it on your computer screen.
 Economy: We realized the difficulty of making money and increased the amount of money earned from customers. We also reduced the price of some products.
 Visual Bugs: Many visual bugs have been fixed.
 Level Arrangements: We rebalanced when certain items unlock to improve game flow.
 Confusion on Day One: On the first day we saw that we had a lot of players who didn't fully understand what to do and how to do it and complained about it. We have added more guidance for the first day.
 Television Portable: You can now move the screen where you can track orders to any position on the wall.
 Multiplayer Issues: Fixed many bugs in Multiplayer. 


We will continue to read your complaints and make adjustments and improvements. Thank you again for supporting us. 
You can join our Discord server and send us your suggestions and complaints directly. 

If you would like to follow our social media accounts, you can find "More Ways To Connect" section below.

notes.title: Sandwich Simulator Early Access Now Open!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=Sjp4LN7I1bY;full][/previewyoutube]
A new flavor of chaos — now on Steam!
Sandwich Simulator is a restaurant simulation game that can be played solo or with up to 4 players in online co-op. Players manage a sandwich shop by taking orders, preparing sandwiches and side items, cleaning the restaurant, and ensuring customer satisfaction. Time management, task coordination, kitchen layout, and restaurant expansion are key elements of the gameplay. The game offers both single-player and cooperative multiplayer.

Sandwich Simulator early access is out now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3445340/?snr=2

To celebrate the game's early access launch, we will be giving away 58 Steam Keys on our Discord server. All you have to do is join our Discord server.

📜 What’s on the Menu?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796113/190131298958c1c07ea75a3029979946f04e59b5.gif

🥪 Make Sandwiches, Not Mistakes

 Bake your bread, stack your ingredients, wrap your creation, serve it fast.
 Simple, right? Not when your grill is full, your orders are piling up, and there’s a queue out the door.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796113/3ba132cea12da6bba2a413ab7b92528f338f3e7a.gif

🍟 Serve Up More Than Sandwiches

 Side dishes include fries, onion rings, nuggets, drinks, coffee, and ice cream!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796113/c666a32f7e7d60b79cdb5a0e809f7357de503a2d.gif

🔥 Time Management Is Key

 Over 10 ingredients, 4 bread types, and endless combinations.
 As your restaurant becomes more popular, orders get more varied and challenging — but also more fun!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796113/ffc9ec98de494ab75f28f2bf08b765aae3f3ed9d.gif

🧼 Clean Kitchen, Happy Guests

 A clean restaurant keeps your customers smiling. 
 Wipe tables, mop floors, take out the trash, and give that restroom some love.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796113/b0710779fa9be7d5a83519ae566404f26530c87d.gif

🚗 Serve More, Earn More

 Accept online orders and deliver them with the help of couriers
 Unlock drive-thru service to reach even more customers without crowding your tables
 A great way to expand your business without expanding your floor space.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796113/d6084b8c1ec692e5b68cbc52bee89fc7feb538ed.gif

🛠️ Build It Your Way

 Rearrange furniture, move your equipment, and design your dream kitchen layout.
 You decide how your restaurant looks and flows. You can change the name and logo of your restaurant!
